faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VB G RAM G North & Middle Andaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the VB G RAM G North & Middle Andaman Recruitment 2026 is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are available for the posts of Programme Officer, Assistant Engineer, Data Entry Operator, and Gram Rozgar Sewak under the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) in North & Middle Andaman District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these government jobs?
faq.answer: Applications for these positions are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with all necessary documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for the Programme Officer post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for the Programme Officer post is an MBA/MSW/BE/B.Sc. (Ag.) OR a Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or any other equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for detailed information on age relaxation rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Data Entry Operator post is ₹14,000/- per month, which includes EPF contributions. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves evaluating candidates based on their Educational Merit, followed by a Skill Test/Computer Trade Test (where applicable), and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply through offline post for this recruitment?
faq.answer: While email is the primary mode of application, the instructions mention that applications can also be submitted by hand or through Registered/Speed Post to the specified address in Mayabunder.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to submit self-attested copies of Educational Qualification Certificates, Proof of Age, Computer Qualification Certificate (where applicable), Experience Certificate(s) (if any), Local Resident Proof, Aadhaar Card, and one recent passport-size photograph.
